verdict.rationale: ReadMe ships an official per-project MCP server that gives AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code Copilot) a live connection to API specs/docs, with dedicated analytics tracking MCP calls, and a runtime probe confirms a live JSON-RPC handshake against ReadMe's own MCP endpoint. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of the MCP server working end-to-end in an external agent workflow, and more detail on tool/resource coverage exposed via the server.
